# std.log

<!-- Generated by `badger doc std` from the checked interfaces (badger 0.1.0). Do not edit by hand. -->

Structured logs. Each record has a level, a message, and fields (any
`Codec` record, encoded by its schema) merged with the context of
enclosing `with` calls; spawned tasks inherit their parent's context.
Records go to standard error as text (`2026-10-16T08:04:05.123Z INFO
order placed id=7`) or JSON lines, by `[runtime] log_level` (`trace`,
`debug`, `info`, `warn`, `error`, `off`; default `info`) and `log_format`
(`text`, `json`, `none`), or `BADGER_LOG_LEVEL` / `BADGER_LOG_FORMAT`. A
level below the threshold costs one check; logging never fails.

```badger
fn debug<T>(message: String, fields: T) -> Unit where T: Codec
```

### `enabled`

```badger
fn enabled(level: Int) -> Bool
```

Whether records of `level` (0 trace .. 4 error) are written.

### `with`

```badger

```

spawns) writes.
